text:
carol: heads up — several customers reporting sudden 502/504s on /v1/generate since the staged rollout this morning. Spike started ~5m after canary. escalation from support@acme included curl output. attaching short repro below.

alice: thanks. which canary? the routing-refactor + shedder-adjust flag we flipped at 09:02?

carol: yes, canary id = rollout-2026-03-15-0902. Support noticed errors from multiple regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1). stack trace showed upstream gateway 502s.

bob: paging oncall. erin you on?

erin: oncall here. I'm pulling grafana now. seeing global 5xx rate jump ~12% -> 40% for the hostpool that got canary. latency p95 also doubled.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: rollout-2026-03-15-0902 by alice at 2026-03-15T09:02:12Z.

alice: the change was to enable "smart-routing-v2" + shedder throttle tweak (max_inflight_per_model 120 -> 60) for the canary subset to improve packing. Thought it would reduce overloads.

bob: can you dump the gateway logs for the canary instances? give me the last 200 lines.

alice: pasted excerpt from gateway logs:
```
[09:07:52] ERROR gateway: upstream returned 502: upstream:ai-runtime /model/infer - connection reset by peer
[09:07:53] WARN gateway: backend RTT spikes: 250ms -> 1200ms
[09:07:54] INFO shedder: rejecting request model=redwood-13b reason=inflight_limit
```

carol: support also sent a sample curl: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` -> `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` with body `{"error":"upstream timeout"}`.

erin: interesting — shedder rejecting due to the new lower inflight cap, but gateway shows RTT spikes and upstream resets. could be backend workers thrashing LRU cache due to routing changes.

alice: the routing-refactor moves some long-context traffic to a separate backend pool. maybe we routed incompatible kv-cache keys and causing cache misses and full reinitializations.

bob: do we have repro that toggles the flag back? can we flip the canary off quickly?

 dave: product wants to avoid full rollback without confirming. but customer impact is high. prioritize safety.

carol: multiple customers flagged production instability — CS recommends immediate rollback of the canary or at least pause.

erin: agreed. I'll coordinate a rollback of the canary subset for safety. alice, prepare the rollback steps.

alice: rollback plan: 1) revert flag `smart-routing-v2` -> off for the canary group via config service; 2) increase `max_inflight_per_model` back to 120 for affected nodes; 3) monitor 5xx and p95 for 10m. command:
```
# revert config
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/v1/flags/rollout-2026-03-15-0902/revert -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

bob: I'll be ready to scale up the worker pool if needed. erin, when you flip the flag, I can run health checks and re-route traffic away from canary hosts.

deploy-bot: Alert: rollback request created by erin for rollout-2026-03-15-0902.

erin: flipping now.

deploy-bot: Flag change: smart-routing-v2 = false for group=canary-2026-03-15 at 2026-03-15T09:15:02Z.

alice: changing inflight cap now.

alice: command run:
```
kubectl exec -n config config-api-0 -- /bin/flagctl set max_inflight_per_model 120 --selector=canary-2026-03-15
```

bob: observed immediate drop in 5xx on canary hosts. global 5xx rate dropping from ~38% -> ~8% in 3 minutes. p95 falling back toward baseline.

carol: notifying affected customers. sending a note: "we paused a staged rollout after detecting elevated 5xx; traffic restored to stable variant; we're investigating root cause and will follow up." :email:

erin: marking incident as mitigation complete. we'll keep monitoring for 30m. also creating a follow-up: deep-dive on routing + KV cache interactions + shedder policy.

alice: initial hypothesis: routing-refactor caused cross-pool KV cache key incompatibility leading to cold-cache thrash; with lower inflight cap shedder rejected in bursts causing gateway 502s as upstream workers were overloaded then reset. need to reproduce in staging.

bob: next actions assigned:
- alice: reproduce locally and add integration test for KV key compatibility (ETA 48h)
- eng-runtime (bob): add telemetry for cache misses per request and tie to routing decision (ETA 72h)
- support/carol: customer comms + postmortem draft (ETA 24h)
- product/dave: evaluate rollout gating criteria and add automated canary health block (ETA 1 week)

carol: closing customer-facing escalation ticket and re-opening internal postmortem thread.

erin: incident status -> mitigated. will convert to P1 follow-up. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
